atoms.claim: 促进心智化是临床工作者理解并认同已在临床工作中进行的工作，MBT为其提供了清晰框架。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: clinicians easily understand the ideas underpinning the model and recognize that promoting mentalizing is something they are already doing in their clinical work.
atoms.extraction_notes: The text states that clinicians recognize promoting mentalizing as already part of their work, implying that MBT focuses on this principle.

atoms.claim: MBT是一种结构化治疗，疗程12-18个月，分个体和团体形式。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: MBT is a structured treatment. It has carefully managed trajectories in terms of both the time in treatment over 12–18 months, and within sessions. It is delivered in individual and group formats.
atoms.extraction_notes: Direct statement from text.

atoms.claim: MBT的治疗目标是增强个体心理化能力的韧性。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The aim of treatment is to increase the resilience of individuals’ mentalizing capacities.
atoms.extraction_notes: Direct statement.

atoms.claim: MBT的核心是当心理化丧失时重新点燃它，当存在时维持它，并增强个体在可能丧失时维持心理化的能力。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The core of MBT is to rekindle mentalizing when it is lost, to maintain it when it is present, and to increase the resilience of the individual’s capacity to keep it going when it would otherwise be lost.
atoms.extraction_notes: Direct statement.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 边缘型人格障碍的人际脆弱性
atoms.claim: 对边缘型人格障碍患者而言，丧失心理化的关键脆弱领域是人际领域，因此临床医患关系是重要关注点。
therapeutic_implications: 关注医患关系
atoms.evidence_excerpt: In the case of people with borderline personality disorder, the key area of vulnerability to losing mentalizing is the interpersonal domain, and so the clinician–patient relationship is a significant area of scrutiny.
atoms.extraction_notes: Direct statement specifying BPD.

atoms.claim: 心智化包含自我反思与人际知觉两大要素。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗中需同时促进患者的自我反思和人际知觉能力。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: 他们明言心智化包含「自我反思」与「人际知觉」两大要素
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引自审阅序。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化理论作为精神分析的补充
atoms.canonical_name_en: mentalizing theory as supplement to psychoanalysis
atoms.claim: 心智化理论为精神分析添加支持性元素，而非取代原有理论与做法。
therapeutic_implications: 对于严重人格障碍患者，心智化方法可提供额外支持；但对一般神经症患者，可能需结合传统精神分析技术。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: 心智化的理论与实务添加了支持性的元素到精神分析的工作内涵当中。
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引自审阅序。

atoms.claim: 心智主体性并非天生，而是逐渐发展或建构出来的能力。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗中需关注患者心智能力的发展性缺失，而非预设其天生完整。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: 我们试图在本书打破这个主流哲学传统，提倡心智主体性应该是种逐渐发展或建构出来的能力。（页35）
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引自审阅序中作者原文引用。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 治疗师自身心智化能力的核心地位
atoms.canonical_name_en: therapist's own mentalizing capacity as core
atoms.claim: 治疗师自身的反思能力、对他人心智的好奇心、持续与未知奋斗却不妄下论断，是心理治疗无可取代的部分。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗师需持续培养自身心智化能力，以作为治疗的基础。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: 治疗师自身的反思能力、对于他人心智的好奇心、持续与未知奋斗却不妄下论断，才是有所修为之处，也是心理治疗或精神分析无可取代的地方
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引自译序。

atoms.claim: 与父母咨询的重点在于协助父母了解孩子情绪困扰或行为问题背后的心理意义。
clinical_signals: 父母无法理解孩子行为
父母寻求解决问题方法
therapeutic_implications: 咨询师应帮助父母心智化孩子的行为
而非直接提供解决方法
response_constraints: 不要流于理智讨论
要以情绪经验理解为主
contraindications: 避免直接给建议
atoms.evidence_excerpt: 与父母咨询的重点在于协助父母了解孩子情绪困扰或行为问题背后的心理意义
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确说明咨询重点。

atoms.claim: 心智化是指人类为情绪和行动赋予意义的能力，依靠发达的大脑皮质。
clinical_signals: 无法理解自己或他人行为背后的心理意义
therapeutic_implications: 心理治疗应着重拓展心智空间
atoms.evidence_excerpt: 发达的大脑皮质使人类能为情绪和行动赋予意义（心智化）
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述心智化是赋予意义的能力。

atoms.claim: 父母透过情感镜映，帮助婴儿发现自己的情感，进而发展情感调节能力，奠定心智化发展。
clinical_signals: 父母无法适当回应孩子的情绪
therapeutic_implications: 在治疗中，治疗师可以通过镜映来访者的情感来促进心智化
atoms.evidence_excerpt: 父母透过情感镜映(affect-mirroring)，帮助婴儿发现自己的情感，进而发展出情感调节(affect regulation)的能力，奠定心智化的发展
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确提到父母情感镜映对婴儿情感发现和调节的作用。

atoms.claim: 心智化情感体会是心理治疗疗效的核心，代表在经验上理解感受而非仅理智理解。
clinical_signals: 来访者仅理智理解感受
therapeutic_implications: 治疗应促进来访者经验性理解自身感受
atoms.evidence_excerpt: 作者在书中特别强调心智化情感体会(mentalized affectivity)是心理治疗介入时疗效的核心
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确指出心智化情感体会是疗效核心。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化发展依赖照顾者
atoms.claim: 心智化能力的发展仰赖主要照顾者，尤其是母亲和父亲。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗中要考虑照顾者的心智化能力
atoms.evidence_excerpt: 心智化的形成是婴儿透过探索他人的心智来理解自己心智的一个历程，所以心智化能力的发展非常仰赖他人，而这个「他人」，则会是我们每个人一出生后的主要照顾者：母亲(及父亲)，我们的原初客体。
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确提到依赖主要照顾者。

atoms.claim: 当一个人没有机会从自己父母的眼中看见自己时，这个人也会很难从自己的眼中看见自己的孩子。
clinical_signals: 父母自身被镜映经验不足
therapeutic_implications: 治疗中需涵容父母的焦虑以帮助他们心智化孩子
atoms.evidence_excerpt: 当一个人没有机会从自己父母的眼中看见自己时，这个人也会很难从自己的眼中看见自己的孩子。
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了代际间心智化能力的传递。

atoms.claim: MBT-A治疗包含每周个体治疗和每月家庭治疗，疗程一年，但可根据需要调整。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗需结合个体与家庭干预
atoms.evidence_excerpt: MBT-A was offered as a combination of individual weekly MBT-A and monthly MBT-Family (MBT-F) treatment. The treatment duration was one year, even though several of the adolescents were able to terminate the treatment earlier than that.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述MBT-A的标准形式。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 青少年羞耻感与自我厌恶
atoms.claim: 社会理解变化和增强的自我意识可能导致童年不安全感被羞耻和自我厌恶取代。
therapeutic_implications: 需识别和处理羞耻感
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Changes in social understanding and increased self-conscious awareness can result in the insecurity and anxiety of childhood being replaced by feelings of shame and self-hatred in adolescence.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述情绪转化。

therapeutic_implications: 治疗师应培养创造力以体现心智化
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Creativity is a sign of a free mind, which in turn is a sign of mentalizing.

atoms.claim: 治疗的目标是增强个体心智化能力的韧性。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗旨在增强心智化韧性
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The aim of treatment is to increase the resilience of individuals’ mentalizing capacities.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接从文本中提取的治疗目标。

atoms.claim: 心智化治疗与其他疗法重叠，但关键区别在于强调心智化作为治疗目标。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The key difference is the extent of the emphasis on mentalizing as the target of treatment.
atoms.extraction_notes: 强调心智化作为治疗目标的核心区别。

atoms.claim: 心智化治疗的核心是在心智化丧失时重新点燃它，在它存在时维持它，并增强个体在可能丧失时保持它的韧性。
therapeutic_implications: 当心智化丧失时，重新点燃；当心智化存在时，维持；增强心智化韧性的保持能力
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The core of MBT is to rekindle mentalizing when it is lost, to maintain it when it is present, and to increase the resilience of the individual’s capacity to keep it going when it would otherwise be lost.
atoms.extraction_notes: 核心任务的三部分描述。

atoms.claim: 对于边缘型人格障碍患者，丧失心智化的关键脆弱领域是人际关系领域，因此治疗关系是重要的审查领域。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗关系需要重点审查
atoms.evidence_excerpt: In the case of people with borderline personality disorder, the key area of vulnerability to losing mentalizing is the interpersonal domain, and so the clinician–patient relationship is a significant area of scrutiny.
atoms.extraction_notes: 特定于BPD患者的声明。

atoms.claim: 心智化治疗首先是协作性的，没有双方的共同讨论，就无法进行任何工作。
therapeutic_implications: 需要共同讨论，考虑双方的心理体验和想法
atoms.evidence_excerpt: First and foremost, MBT is collaborative. Nothing can occur without joint discussion, taking into account the mental experiences and ideas of both patient and clinician.
atoms.extraction_notes: 强调协作是首要原则。

atoms.claim: 治疗师关注患者的心智，患者也被要求对治疗师采取同样的做法。
therapeutic_implications: 鼓励患者思考治疗师的心智状态
atoms.evidence_excerpt: So the MBT clinician focuses on the patient’s mind and attempts to understand his/her experience. Similarly, the patient is asked to do the same in relation to the clinician
atoms.extraction_notes: 互换心智化的要求。

atoms.claim: MBT的首要特点是合作性，治疗过程需要患者和临床医生的共同讨论。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗需要患者和临床医生共同讨论，考虑双方的心理经验和想法
atoms.evidence_excerpt: First and foremost, MBT is collaborative. Nothing can occur without joint discussion, taking into account the mental experiences and ideas of both patient and clinician.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述合作是首要的。

atoms.claim: formulation 是一个不断进行中的工作，可以随时修改。
therapeutic_implications: 临床医生和患者应认识到 formulation 是可变的
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The formulation is a work in progress and can be changed at any time.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述。

atoms.claim: 临床医生需仔细监控患者的唤醒水平，确保焦虑既不太低也不太高，因为两者都会干扰心智化。
therapeutic_implications: 调节焦虑水平以促进心智化
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Second, the clinician monitors arousal levels carefully, ensuring that anxiety is neither too low nor too high, as both interfere with mentalizing.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用。

atoms.claim: 治疗师需仔细监测患者的唤醒水平，确保焦虑既不过高也不过低，因为两者都会干扰心智化。
therapeutic_implications: 调节焦虑水平以维持心智化
注意过高或过低焦虑的负面影响
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Second, the clinician monitors arousal levels carefully, ensuring that anxiety is neither too low nor too high, as both interfere with mentalizing.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述监测唤醒水平的必要性。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 维持治疗师自身心智化
atoms.claim: 治疗师需确保自身心智化能力不受损，必要时向患者暴露心智状态的混乱，以促进患者考虑他者的心智。
clinical_signals: 治疗师感到自己心智混乱
therapeutic_implications: 自我监测心智化状态
适度自我暴露以示范心智化
response_constraints: 自我暴露仅限于心智状态，不分享个人私事
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Fourth, the clinician makes sure that his/her own mentalizing is maintained. It is not possible to deliver effective treatment if the clinician’s mentalizing is compromised. So the MBT clinician always monitors his/her own capacities and may even have to say, for example, that his/her mind has become muddled and he/she cannot think. This type of self-disclosure of the mind state of the clinician should not be confused with sharing personal information.
atoms.extraction_notes: 强调治疗师心智化的重要性及自我暴露的边界。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 治疗师的自我心智化监控
atoms.claim: 治疗师必须始终监控自己的心智化能力，如果心智化受损，则无法提供有效治疗。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗师可能需要承认自己思维混乱，无法思考
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Fourth, the clinician makes sure that his/her own mentalizing is maintained. It is not possible to deliver effective treatment if the clinician’s mentalizing is compromised. So the MBT clinician always monitors his/her own capacities and may even have to say, for example, that his/her mind has become muddled and he/she cannot think.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述

atoms.claim: 治疗师暴露自己的心智状态不应与分享个人信息混淆。
therapeutic_implications: 暴露治疗师受患者言行和心态影响的效果，旨在让患者考虑他人的心智
atoms.evidence_excerpt: This type of self-disclosure of the mind state of the clinician should not be confused with sharing personal information.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述

atoms.claim: 心理化取向治疗的会谈是聚焦的，而非自由联想式的，目标区域是工作记忆或前意识经验。
therapeutic_implications: 会谈应在10-15分钟内确立焦点，并以此为中心导向
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Sessions are focused. They do not consist of free associative dialogue that seeks to illuminate unconscious process. The target area is working memory or pre-consciously held experience.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述

atoms.claim: 澄清不仅包括事件事实，更重要的是确立患者对事件的反思，如事前心态、希望、体验等。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗师应询问患者的状态、想法、感受等
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Clarification establishes the reflection the patient has on the events—what was their “pre-morbid” state of mind, what were their hopes, what was their experience when they were waiting for their boyfriend to return home, what thoughts intruded into their mind, what feelings did they identify, and can they reflect on it differently now?
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述

atoms.claim: 澄清不仅包括快速弄清事件事实，还通过询问患者事件前的心理状态、希望、感受等来激发心智化。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Clarification establishes the reflection the patient has on the events—what was their “pre-morbid” state of mind, what were their hopes, what was their experience when they were waiting for their boyfriend to return home, what thoughts intruded into their mind, what feelings did they identify, and can they reflect on it differently now?

atoms.claim: 移情标记是将患者当前与治疗师的关系模式与既往人际关系模式进行简单链接的陈述，不打断会谈焦点。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Transference tracers are straightforward links between patterns of relationships over time, or bridging statements that establish similarities between the patient’s attitudes and behaviors toward people in his/her life and the way he/she relates to the clinician

atoms.claim: 心智化治疗关系是在情绪互动中保持心智化，为处理日常人际关系中的困难情感提供训练。
clinical_signals: 治疗关系中激活的依恋策略
therapeutic_implications: 通过共情验证、承认临床工作者贡献、探索发展复杂理解来管理互动
response_constraints: 必须真心好奇，不暗示患者体验扭曲
contraindications: 无效化态度会导致灾难，引起过度 arousal 和心智化降低
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mentalizing the relationship in a session is the training ground for managing difficult feelings in interpersonal situations in daily life through maintaining mentalizing while within an emotional interaction.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确指出心智化治疗关系的功能。

atoms.claim: 无效化（非相称回应）会导致过度 arousal 和心智化降低。
clinical_signals: 临床工作者暗示患者体验不准确
therapeutic_implications: 必须避免无效化态度，否则会破坏心智化
response_constraints: 临床工作者需找到可以验证的部分患者体验
contraindications: 无效化是禁忌
atoms.evidence_excerpt: invalidation, a non-contingent response, leads to excessive arousal and a consequent reduction in mentalizing.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述无效化导致的结果。

atoms.claim: 治疗师可以预期患者反应，例如告知患者即将说的话可能让患者感到被指责或批评，但这不是事实。
clinical_signals: 患者可能感到被指责或批评
therapeutic_implications: 治疗师明确表达自己的意图，减少误解
atoms.evidence_excerpt: It is possible that what I am going to say may make you feel I am telling you off or being critical but I assure you that is not the case [anticipating the response of the patient].
atoms.extraction_notes: The excerpt explicitly describes this as anticipating the patient's response.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 识别行为证据并呈现自身情感
atoms.canonical_name_en: identifying behavioral evidence and presenting own affect
atoms.claim: 治疗师可以识别患者的行为证据（如身体姿势、语气），并呈现自身的情感（如焦虑）以及该行为对治疗师的影响。
clinical_signals: 患者表现出威胁性姿势或语气
therapeutic_implications: 帮助患者理解其行为对他人的影响
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The problem is that when you sit forward like that, stabbing the air with your finger, and raise your voice, I start to feel anxious and under threat [identifying the behavioral evidence and focus of external mentalizing, presenting his own affect and the effect it has on him].
atoms.extraction_notes: Bracketed text clarifies the intervention.

atoms.claim: 治疗师标示自身的感受（可能属于治疗师自己），并说明这种感受干扰了治疗关系。
clinical_signals: 患者行为引发治疗师强烈感受
therapeutic_implications: 促进患者对治疗师内在状态的思考
atoms.evidence_excerpt: I realize that this may be me [marking the feeling] but it makes it difficult for me to concentrate on what you are talking about [additional effect on him interfering with the relationship].
atoms.extraction_notes: Bracketed text indicates the clinician's marking of feeling.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 威胁性态度和愤怒表现
atoms.claim: 如果患者的威胁性态度和愤怒表现渗透在所有关系中，则需要进一步探索。
therapeutic_implications: 深入探索患者行为模式
atoms.evidence_excerpt: But if the threatening attitude and angry presentation is something that permeates all the patient’s relationships, then further exploration is essential.
atoms.extraction_notes: Direct statement about pervasiveness requiring further exploration.

atoms.claim: 与他人进行心智化是满意社交和个人关系的基础，这必然是我们所有人的目标。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗目标应促进患者与他人心智化的能力
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mentalizing with others is the basis of satisfactory social and personal relationships, which must surely be the goal of us all.
atoms.extraction_notes: Statement about the importance of mentalizing for relationships.

atoms.claim: 心智化是以思想、感受、愿望和欲望来理解自己和他人的行为的能力。
therapeutic_implications: 心智化是治疗的基础
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mentalizing is the ability to understand actions by both other people and oneself in terms of thoughts, feelings, wishes, and desires; it is a very human capability that underpins everyday interactions
atoms.extraction_notes: Direct definition from text.

atoms.claim: 心智化治疗最初是在20世纪90年代为在日间医院治疗边缘性人格障碍患者而开发的。
therapeutic_implications: MBT最初应用于BPD
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mentalization-based treatment (MBT) was originally developed in the 1990s and initially used to treat patients with borderline personality disorder (BPD) in a partial (day) hospital setting.
atoms.extraction_notes: Clear origin statement.

atoms.claim: 心智化是一个基本的心理过程，在所有主要精神障碍中都起作用。
therapeutic_implications: 增强心智化有益于多种障碍
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mentalizing is a fundamental psychological process that has a role to play in all major mental disorders.
atoms.extraction_notes: Direct statement.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化是人类独特能力
atoms.claim: 心智化是人类独特的能力，定义了人性并使人类与其他高等灵长类动物区别开来。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mentalizing is a uniquely human capacity—it can be seen as what defines humanity and separates us from other higher-order primates.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化能力的不稳定性
atoms.claim: 心智化能力并非完全稳定、一致或一维的。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: this capacity is not an entirely stable, consistent, or one-dimensional thing

atoms.claim: 并非所有人都能同等程度地心智化，许多人在特定方面有优势或弱点。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: We are not all able to mentalize to the same extent; many of us have strengths or weaknesses in particular aspects of mentalizing

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 压力或焦虑损害心智化
atoms.claim: 大多数人在压力或焦虑时更容易在心智化上挣扎。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: most of us are more likely to struggle to mentalize in moments of stress or anxiety.

atoms.claim: 所有人都或多或少经历过心智化失误。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: All of us have experienced mentalizing lapses to a greater or lesser extent.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 基于心理状态的理解比物理解释更难
atoms.canonical_name_en: Mental state understanding more difficult than physical explanations
atoms.claim: 试图根据心理状态理解他人行为几乎总是比基于物理环境的解释更困难且更容易出错。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Trying to understand other people’s behavior in terms of mental states is almost always more difficult and more liable to go wrong than explanations based on the impact of the physical environment

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化是前意识的想象性心理活动
atoms.claim: 心智化主要是一种前意识的、想象性的心理活动：我们必须想象他人可能在想什么或感受什么。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mentalizing is a mostly preconscious, imaginative mental activity: we have to imagine what other people might be thinking or feeling.

atoms.claim: 心智化是从外部看自己，从内部看他人。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: In essence, mentalizing is seeing ourselves from the outside and others from the inside.
atoms.extraction_notes: Definition from first sentence.

atoms.claim: 心智化是自我感和身份认同的主干。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mentalizing, the representation of our mental states, is the spine of our sense of self and identity
atoms.extraction_notes: Direct statement.

atoms.claim: 看到自己和他人的心理状态是能动和有意图的，可理解的，这创造了必要的心理连贯性以应对复杂社交世界。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Seeing oneself and others as agentive and intentional beings driven by mental states that are meaningful and understandable creates the psychological coherence about self and others that is essential for navigating a complex social world.
atoms.extraction_notes: Function of mentalizing.

atoms.claim: 内部状态（情绪、想法等）是不透明的，我们对其进行推断。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Central concept is that internal states (emotions, thoughts, etc.) are opaque. We make inferences about them.
atoms.extraction_notes: From central ideas box.

atoms.claim: 推断容易出错，因此心智化很容易出问题。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Inferences are prone to error and so mentalizing easily goes awry.
atoms.extraction_notes: From central ideas box.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 自动心智化的环境敏感性
atoms.claim: 自动心智化的能力似乎是早期出现且可能是人类固有的，但充分心智化的潜在程度并非由基因决定，且对环境的影响高度敏感。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The capacity for automatic mentalizing seems to be an early emerging and possibly innate human characteristic, but the extent to which the potential for full mentalizing is achieved is unlikely to be genetically determined and appears to be highly responsive to environmental influences

atoms.claim: 父母作为“专家心智化者”，其任务是向孩子传达心智状态概念以及表征这些概念的方式。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: More generally, parents, in the role of “expert mentalizers,” have the task of communicating mental state concepts, and ways of representing these concepts, to their children.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述父母作为专家心智化者的角色和任务。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 早期暴露于不良心智化
atoms.canonical_name_en: early exposure to poor mentalizing interactions
atoms.claim: 早期暴露于以不良心智化为特征的互动会导致孩子也发展出不良的心智化能力。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: early exposure to interactions characterized by poor mentalizing will lead the child to develop poor mentalizing too.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确早期不良心智化互动对儿童心智化发展的负面后果。

atoms.canonical_name_en: format for representing mental state concepts
atoms.claim: 父母通过与孩子互动以及在其面前互动，生成了一种能够表征心理状态概念的格式。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The parent, through their interactions with and in the presence of the child, generates a format with which mental state concepts can be represented.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确父母通过互动创造心理概念表征格式。

atoms.claim: 控制心智化是序列、相对缓慢的过程，通常依赖语言并需要反思、注意、觉察、意图和努力；自动心智化则快速、反射性，几乎不需要注意、觉察、意图或努力。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Controlled mentalizing reflects a serial and relatively slow process, which is typically verbal and demands reflection, attention, awareness, intention, and effort. The opposite pole of this dimension, automatic mentalizing, involves much faster processing, tends to be reflexive, and requires little or no attention, awareness, intention, or effort.
atoms.extraction_notes: Definition of the automatic-controlled dimension from page 25.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 日常互动中的自动心智化
atoms.claim: 在日常生活和普通社交互动中，大多数心智化是自动的，因为大多数直接交流不需要更多注意。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: In day-to-day life and ordinary social interaction, most of our mentalizing tends to be automatic because most straightforward exchanges do not require more attention.
atoms.extraction_notes: From page 25.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 安全依恋中的控制心智化放松
atoms.canonical_name_en: relaxed controlled mentalizing in secure attachment
atoms.claim: 在安全依恋环境中，当人际关系顺利运行时，不需要更多刻意或控制心智化；事实上，使用这种心智化风格可能妨碍互动，使互动显得过于沉重或不适当地过度思考（过度心智化）。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Particularly in a secure attachment environment, when things are running smoothly on an interpersonal level, more deliberate or controlled mentalizing is not called for; in fact, the use of such a mentalizing style might hinder such interactions, making them feel unduly weighty or uncomfortably overwrought (hypermentalized).
atoms.extraction_notes: From page 25.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 人格障碍中心智化失衡
atoms.claim: 在患有人格障碍的成人中，至少在这四个维度之一上存在明显的心智化失衡。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: In an adult with personality disorder, imbalanced mentalizing on at least one of these four dimensions would be evident.
atoms.extraction_notes: From page 25.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 关系对儿童心理状态假设的影响
atoms.canonical_name_en: influence of relationships on child's assumptions about mental states
atoms.claim: 关系会影响儿童关于心理状态的起源、位置和功能的假设。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: relationships will influence the child’s assumptions about the origin, location, and functioning of mental states.
atoms.extraction_notes: From page 25.

atoms.claim: 神经科学家识别出心智化的四个不同组成部分或维度：自动与控制心智化、自我与他人心智化、内部与外部特征心智化、认知与情感心智化。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Neuroscientists have identified four different components, or dimensions, to mentalizing (Lieberman, 2007), which are helpful to distinguish in clinical applications of the concept. These are: 1 Automatic versus controlled mentalizing 2 Mentalizing the self versus others 3 Mentalizing with regard to internal versus external features 4 Cognitive versus affective mentalizing.
atoms.extraction_notes: From page 25.

atoms.claim: 功能良好的心智化涉及从自动化到控制性心智化灵活、响应性地切换的能力。
clinical_signals: 根据情境切换心智化模式
therapeutic_implications: 治疗应培养患者灵活切换的能力
atoms.evidence_excerpt: well-functioning mentalizing involves the ability to switch flexibly and responsively from automatic to controlled mentalizing.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用原文关于良好心智化能力的表述。

atoms.claim: 从本质上说，任何有效的治疗都是关于让患者心智化。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗应以促进心智化为核心
atoms.evidence_excerpt: any effective treatment is, at that level, about getting the patient to mentalize
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用文本中关于有效治疗核心的表述。

atoms.claim: 自动系统发展较早，快速高效地追踪心理状态；外显系统发展较晚，运行较慢，对执行功能要求更高。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The automatic system develops early and tracks mental states in a fast and efficient way, while the explicit system develops later, operates more slowly, and makes heavier demands on executive functions (working memory and inhibitory control).
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述

atoms.claim: 他人聚焦的个体更容易受到情绪感染。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Other focus: ● Greater susceptibility to emotional contagion
atoms.extraction_notes: From Box 1.4.

atoms.claim: 他人聚焦与准确解读他人想法相关，但缺乏对自身内心世界的理解。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Associated with accuracy in reading the mind of others without any real understanding of own inner world
atoms.extraction_notes: From Box 1.4.

atoms.claim: 自我聚焦的个体对自身状态存在过度心理化。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Self focus: ● Hypermentalizing of own state
atoms.extraction_notes: From Box 1.4.

atoms.claim: 自我聚焦的个体对感知他人状态的能力或兴趣有限。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Limited interest in or capacity to perceive others’ states
atoms.extraction_notes: From Box 1.4.

atoms.claim: 他人聚焦可能导向对他人的利用和滥用，或自身被利用。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: May lead to exploitation and misuse of other, or to being exploited
atoms.extraction_notes: From Box 1.4.

atoms.claim: 自我聚焦可能导向自我扩张。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: May lead to self-aggrandizement
atoms.extraction_notes: From Box 1.4.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心理化神经系统的相互抑制
atoms.canonical_name_en: mutual inhibition of mentalizing neural systems
atoms.claim: 共享表征系统与心理状态归因系统可能相互抑制，抑制模仿行为的神经区域与负责外显心理状态归因的区域重叠。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: these two systems may be mutually inhibitory (Brass, Ruby, & Spengler, 2009), in that the neural regions most often recruited in the inhibition of imitative behavior are those involved in explicit mental state attributions.
atoms.extraction_notes: Direct statement from text.

atoms.claim: 内部-外部维度不仅适用于他人，也适用于自我，包括思考自己和自己的内在与外在状态。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: this dimension does not just refer to a process of focusing on the externally visible manifestations versus the internal mental state of others, it also applies to the self—it includes thinking about oneself and one’s own internal and external states.
atoms.extraction_notes: from page 29, PART 1

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化受损与外部敏感
atoms.claim: 一些患者在理解他人心智方面严重受损，但对面部表情或身体姿势过度敏感。
clinical_signals: hypersensitivity to facial expressions or bodily posture
atoms.evidence_excerpt: some patients appear to be seriously impaired in their capacity to “read the mind” of others, yet they may be hypersensitive to facial expressions or bodily posture
atoms.extraction_notes: from page 29

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 通过外部行为推断感受
atoms.claim: 对主观体验缺乏自信的人可能通过观察自己的行为和他人反应来推断自己的感受。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Someone who has poor access to and great uncertainty about their subjective experience may come to a conclusion about what they are feeling from observing their own behavior as well as the reactions of others: their legs feel restless, therefore they must be feeling anxious.
atoms.extraction_notes: from page 29

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 缺乏内在知识导致寻求外部线索
atoms.canonical_name_en: Lack of Internal Knowledge Drives Clue-Seeking
atoms.claim: 缺乏对内在的自信知识会导致渴望他人反应的线索，即使这些反应并非针对自己。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The absence of confident knowledge about the internal creates a thirst for clues from others’ reactions even when these are not directed at oneself.
atoms.extraction_notes: from page 29

atoms.claim: 在缺乏反思性心智化的情况下，集中关注外部特征会使个体在社会情境中高度脆弱。
clinical_signals: 社交情境中的高敏感性
therapeutic_implications: MBT干预需从探讨患者对外部线索的解释开始
atoms.evidence_excerpt: A focus on external features, in the absence of reflective mentalizing, makes an individual highly vulnerable in social contexts
atoms.extraction_notes: 描述了非心智化模式的一种表现及其后果。

atoms.claim: 在MBT中，心智化干预通常需要先检查患者基于外部线索对一个人的解释，然后考虑关于其内部心理状态的可能合理情景。
clinical_signals: 患者对外部线索的过度解读
therapeutic_implications: 逐步引导患者关注内部心理状态的微妙性与复杂性
atoms.evidence_excerpt: In MBT, mentalizing interventions often need to start by examining the patient’s interpretations of a person based on external cues and then go on to consider possible plausible scenarios about what their internal states of mind may be—encouraging the patient to take into account the subtleties and complexities of people’s internal worlds.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了MBT干预的步骤。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 情绪与心智化的不相容性
atoms.canonical_name_en: incompatibility of intense emotion and mentalizing
atoms.claim: 强烈情绪与对心理状态的严肃反思似乎是不相容的。
clinical_signals: 高情绪唤醒时心智化能力下降
therapeutic_implications: 在患者情绪激动时需调节情绪以促进心智化
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Intense emotion appears to be incompatible with serious reflection on mental states.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: BPD患者的认知同理心缺陷与情绪敏感性
atoms.canonical_name_en: BPD cognitive empathy deficit and emotional hypersensitivity
atoms.claim: 研究表明BPD患者存在认知同理心缺陷，同时伴有对任何情绪线索的高度敏感性。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗中需注意患者对情绪线索的过度解读
帮助患者区分认知与情感心智化
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Studies have suggested that BPD patients have a deficit of cognitive empathy (Harari, Shamay-Tsoory, Ravid, & Levkovitz, 2010; Ritter et al., 2011), which is coupled with heightened sensitivity toward any kind of emotional cue (Lynch et al., 2006).
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确提及BPD患者的特征，未在原文中限定为成人，但根据来源meta data定为成人。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化的情境与关系依赖性
atoms.claim: 心智化随时间变化，特定的情境和刺激更容易导致心智化困难。
clinical_signals: 在特定情境下心智化能力波动
therapeutic_implications: 评估患者在日常生活情境中的心智化表现，而非仅依赖实验室测量
atoms.evidence_excerpt: mentalizing changes over time, and particular situations and stimuli are more likely to lead to mentalizing difficulties.
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自第14页，描述心智化的动态性和情境特异性。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 可控心智化与自动心智化的转换
atoms.canonical_name_en: Shift from controlled to automatic mentalizing
atoms.claim: 在情绪唤起状态下，个体通常失去可控心智化的能力，难以想象解释他人心理状态的理性场景。
clinical_signals: 情绪唤起时无法进行理性反思
therapeutic_implications: 帮助患者识别情绪唤起早期信号，以防止完全失去可控心智化
atoms.evidence_excerpt: when in a state of emotional arousal, they typically lose the ability for controlled mentalizing and are likely to struggle to imagine a rational scenario that might explain the states of mind of others.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述情绪唤起与心智化能力下降的关系。

atoms.claim: 情感聚焦的心智化维度与以下特征相关：对情感线索过度敏感、增加情绪感染易感性、思考心理状态时易被情感淹没、以及自我-情感命题性理解。
therapeutic_implications: 帮助患者调节情感距离以维持有效心智化
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Affective focus: ● Oversensitivity to emotional cues ● Increased susceptibility to emotional contagion ● Tendency to be overwhelmed by affect when thinking about states of mind ● Self-affect propositional understanding
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自Box 1.6，明确定义情感聚焦。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 情绪唤醒对心智化的影响
atoms.claim: 情绪唤醒时，人们难以关注他人视角，并容易基于不充分的观察做出假设。
clinical_signals: 基于不充分观察做出假设
therapeutic_implications: 帮助患者调节情绪唤起水平
在情绪高涨时减少对心智化的要求
atoms.evidence_excerpt: When emotional, not only does it become much harder or even impossible to concern oneself with the other person’s perspective; we can also be quick to make assumptions on the basis of flimsy observations.
atoms.extraction_notes: Direct statement about effect of emotional arousal on mentalizing.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 依恋系统激活与心智化去激活
atoms.canonical_name_en: attachment system activation and mentalizing deactivation
atoms.claim: 依恋系统的激活与心智化的去激活相关。
therapeutic_implications: 在依恋激活情境中预期心智化能力下降
atoms.evidence_excerpt: There is also some evidence that the activation of the attachment system is linked with the deactivation of mentalizing.
atoms.extraction_notes: Direct claim supported by imaging studies.

atoms.claim: 心理等价模式在约20个月大的幼儿（尚未发展完整心智化能力）以及患有边缘型人格障碍的患者中常见。
clinical_signals: 主观体验的过度确定性
例如'床下有老虎'或'药物在伤害我'的想法
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Young children, and patients with BPD who are in this mode, describe an overriding sense of certainty about their subjective experience
atoms.extraction_notes: Text ties psychic equivalence mode to young children and BPD patients.

atoms.claim: 心理等价状态可能极其可怕，给生活经历增添强烈的戏剧性和风险感。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Such a state of mind can be extremely frightening, adding a powerful sense of drama and risk to life experiences.
atoms.extraction_notes: Describes affective experience of psychic equivalence.

atoms.claim: 临床医生必须采取整体人的视角，处理患者的现象学或主观性。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗师应关注患者的主观体验
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The whole-person perspective that clinicians are obliged to take must address the phenomenology or subjectivity of our patients.
atoms.extraction_notes: Direct statement about clinician stance.

atoms.claim: 心理等价模式中，心理现实等于外部现实，内心与外部具有相同的力量，想法感觉真实。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗师避免卷入非心智化对话
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mind–world isomorphism: mental reality equals outer reality
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用Box 1.7中的第一项。

atoms.claim: 心理等价模式下，自我相关的负面认知可能感觉‘太真实’，缺乏‘仿佛’特质。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Self-related negative cognitions may be felt to be “too real”—absence of “as if” quality
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用Box 1.7中的一项。

atoms.claim: 心理等价模式反映了自我情感状态思维的支配，内部聚焦有限。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Reflects domination of self-affect state thinking with limited internal focus
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用Box 1.7中的描述。

atoms.claim: 在目的性模式中，个体倾向于从物理而非心理约束来理解行动
clinical_signals: 过度依赖物理可观察性
将行为理解为物理行为
只有物理世界的改变才被视为他人意图的真正指标
表现出产生可观察结果的行为
暂时丧失控制性心理化
atoms.evidence_excerpt: A focus on understanding actions in terms of their physical as opposed to mental constraints
atoms.extraction_notes: From Box 1.8, first bullet point

atoms.claim: 在假装模式中，想法不能连接内心与外在现实；心理世界与外在现实分离
clinical_signals: 想法不能连接内外现实
心理世界与外在现实分离
听者感觉话语空洞、无意义、无关紧要且循环
情感与思维内容不匹配
出现解离、过度心理化或伪心理化
显性心理化被隐性的、不充分的内部聚焦主导
信念-欲望推理差，易与他人融合
therapeutic_implications: 在治疗中需通过打断非心理化过程来管理
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Ideas do not form a bridge between inner and outer reality; the mental world is severed from outer reality
atoms.extraction_notes: From Box 1.9, first bullet point

atoms.claim: 因缺乏内隐和外显心理化，可能为达到目的性目的而误用心理化，例如伤害他人
clinical_signals: 为达到目的性目的误用心理化
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Misuse of mentalizing for teleological ends (e.g., harming others) becomes possible because of lack of implicit as well as explicit mentalizing.
atoms.extraction_notes: From Box 1.8, last bullet point

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 治疗中打断非心理化过程
atoms.claim: 在假装模式下，治疗中需通过打断非心理化过程来管理
therapeutic_implications: 在治疗中中断非心理化过程
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Managed in therapy by interrupting nonmentalizing process when it occurs.
atoms.extraction_notes: From Box 1.9, last bullet point

atoms.claim: 当情感主导认知时，心理等价模式不可避免。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Psychic equivalence is inevitable if emotion (affect) dominates cognition.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述心理等价模式的条件。

atoms.claim: 目的论模式源于对外部特征的排他性关注而忽视内部。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Teleological mode follows from an exclusive focus on external features to the neglect of the internal.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述目的论模式的来源。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心理化失败与自我碎片化
atoms.claim: 心理化产生自我连贯性，心理化失败会导致碎片感，个体常通过极端甚至暴力行为来寻求庇护。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Because mentalizing generates self-coherence, the faltering of mentalizing can signal a sense of fragmentation, a painful state from which we often seek shelter by extreme and even violent acts.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述心理化与自我连贯性的关系及失败后果。

atoms.claim: 个体通过过度自信、忽视他人视角、创造自我服务的形象以及迫使对方反应来维持自我连贯性和真实感。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: I may achieve this by: 1 Being excessively assertive (raising my voice) 2 Blinding myself to the potentially “confusing” perspective of my friend 3 Creating an image of him that is highly self-serving and confirms me in my position as coherent, accurate, and, above all, beyond reproach 4 Forcing a reaction from him to affirm me still further or make me feel “even more real.”
atoms.extraction_notes: 列举四种具体策略，直接引用原文。

atoms.claim: 对于人格障碍患者，外化的需要可能感觉像生死攸关，而不仅仅是暂时的解脱。
clinical_signals: 患者可能表现出强烈的、迫切的将内在体验外化的倾向
therapeutic_implications: 临床医生需要认识到外化对患者的重要性，并主动监测自身感受
atoms.evidence_excerpt: In people with personality disorder, the need for this externalizing can feel like a matter of life and death, not just a momentary relief from discomfort.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述了人格障碍患者外化需要的强度。

atoms.claim: 异己自我可能成为受虐待体验的载体，容纳一种真正恶意的意向性，并通过不受调节的自我毁灭从内部表达其恶意意图。
clinical_signals: 患者可能表现出不受调节的自我毁灭行为
therapeutic_implications: 临床医生需要警惕异己自我可能携带的恶意意向性
atoms.evidence_excerpt: This is because the alien self can frequently become the vehicle for the experience of maltreatment, the host to a genuinely malevolent intentionality that has taken residence inside the self and expresses its malevolent intent from within through unmoderated self-destructiveness (see Box 1.11).
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了异己自我与受虐待体验和自我毁灭的关系。

atoms.claim: 外化倾向通常在儿童早期建立并根深蒂固。
clinical_signals: 患者可能表现出早期形成的外化模式
therapeutic_implications: 临床医生应认识到外化倾向的早期根源和顽固性
atoms.evidence_excerpt: ◆ Tendency to externalization is usually established early in childhood and deeply entrenched
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述了外化倾向的早期建立和根深蒂固。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 控制外化异己自我的程度
atoms.canonical_name_en: control degree of externalization of alien self
atoms.claim: 患者外化异己自我的程度必须被仔细控制，因为过多的退行性付诸行动会破坏利用关系增强心智化的机会。
clinical_signals: 患者频繁将负面特质归因于治疗师
therapeutic_implications: 治疗师需设定界限
避免鼓励过度退行
response_constraints: 限制患者外化异己自我的程度
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The degree to which patients engage in externalization of the alien self must be carefully controlled; too many regressive enactments will undermine any opportunity for using that relationship to enhance mentalizing.
atoms.extraction_notes: 治疗原则：控制外化程度。

atoms.claim: 患者对他人作为异己自我载体的需求可能变得压倒性，并发展出粘附性、成瘾性的假性依恋。
clinical_signals: 患者对特定他人产生粘附性、成瘾性的假性依恋
therapeutic_implications: 治疗中需注意患者对治疗师的假性依恋
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The need for the other as a vehicle for the alien self can be overwhelming, as the patient experiences it as a matter for survival, and an adhesive, addictive pseudo-attachment to this individual can develop.
atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确描述了异己自我载体需求与假性依恋的关系。

atoms.claim: 认识论信任理论强调个体对来自他人的社会信息是否视为真实且与个人相关的信任程度。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗中需建立患者的认识论信任以促进改变
atoms.evidence_excerpt: this theory emphasizes the social and emotional significance of the trust we place in the information about the social world that we receive from another person—that is, the extent and ways in which we are able to consider social knowledge as genuine and personally relevant to us
atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确描述了认识论信任的定义。

atoms.claim: 对儿童需求的敏感回应不仅培养其作为人的一般信心，还打开其心智以接收新信息并改变信念和行为。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗中敏感回应患者需求可促进其心智开放和学习
atoms.evidence_excerpt: sensitive responding to the child’s need fosters not just a general confidence that he/she matters as a person, but also serves to open his/her mind more generally to receive new information as relevant and alter his/her beliefs and modify his/her future behavior accordingly.
atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确描述了敏感回应的双重作用。

atoms.claim: 认识论信任是一种人类特有的、由线索驱动的社会认知适应，旨在确保相关文化知识的有效传递。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: A human-specific, cue-driven social cognitive adaptation of mutual design dedicated to ensure efficient transfer of relevant cultural knowledge
atoms.extraction_notes: Box 1.12 中的第一点直接定义了认识论信任。

atoms.claim: 人类天生倾向于相互传授和学习新的、相关的文化信息。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Humans are predisposed to “teach” and “learn” new and relevant cultural information from each other
atoms.extraction_notes: Box 1.12 中的第二点。

atoms.claim: 人类交流特别适应于传递认知上不透明的文化知识、可泛化的种类通用知识和共享文化知识。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Human communication is specifically adapted to allow the transmission of: ● Cognitively opaque cultural knowledge ● Kind-generalizable generic knowledge ● Shared cultural knowledge.
atoms.extraction_notes: Box 1.12 中的第三点。

atoms.claim: 早期发展中与敏感回应者形成的依恋为产生认识论信任提供了特殊条件，并提供了安全感的认知优势。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Attachment to a person who responded sensitively in early development provides a special condition for generating epistemic trust—provides cognitive advantage of security
atoms.extraction_notes: Box 1.13 中的第一点。

atoms.claim: 通过识别听者作为意向主体而“标记”的交流将增加认识论信任，并使交流更可能被编码为与听者相关、可泛化到即时情境之外、并作为相关信息保留在记忆中。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Communication that is “marked” by recognition of the listener as an intentional agent will increase epistemic trust and the likelihood of the communication being coded as: ● Relevant to the listener ● Generalizable to situations beyond the immediate one ● To be retained in memory as relevant
atoms.extraction_notes: Box 1.13 中的第二点。

atoms.claim: 明示线索触发认识论信任，进而触发一种特殊的注意力，将知识理解为与“我”相关。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Ostensive cues trigger epistemic trust, which triggers a special kind of attention to knowledge that is understood as relevant to “me.”
atoms.extraction_notes: Box 1.13 中的第三点。

atoms.claim: 社会经历可能导致个体处于慢性认识论不信任状态，在这种状态下，他们可能（由于过度心智化）想象交流者的动机是恶意的。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: But what of individuals whose social experiences have led them to a state of chronic epistemic mistrust, in which (perhaps because of hypermentalizing) they imagine the motives of the communicator to be malign?
atoms.extraction_notes: 正文中的问题，描述了慢性认识论不信任及其与过度心智化的可能关联。

atoms.claim: 安全依恋的儿童更可能将照顾者视为可靠的知识来源，并且这种信任可能泛化到其他可以教学和学习的人。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: A securely attached child is more likely to treat the caregiver as a reliable source of knowledge, and this trust is likely to generalize to other people in a position to teach and learn from.
atoms.extraction_notes: 正文中关于安全依恋与认识论信任泛化的陈述。

atoms.claim: 先前的经历可能破坏认知信任，从而部分阻塞进化上准备好的获取个人相关信息通道。
clinical_signals: 对来自他人的新信息持深度怀疑
therapeutic_implications: 需要修复认知信任以促进学习
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Their epistemic trust has been undermined by their previous experiences, and as a consequence an evolutionarily prepared channel for the acquisition of personally relevant information is partially blocked.

atoms.claim: 每个人都寻求社会知识以帮助导航人际世界，且常对自己的信念和直觉感到不安，需要他人的输入和 reassurance。
therapeutic_implications: 理解患者寻求确认的正常需求
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Everybody seeks social knowledge to help navigate the interpersonal world. We are all often insecure in relation to our own beliefs and intuitions, and seek input and reassurance from others.

atoms.claim: 有创伤史的个体没有理由信任，会拒绝与现有信念不一致的信息，表现出明显的僵化或不愿改变。
therapeutic_implications: 患者可能被临床医生视为难以接触
atoms.evidence_excerpt: An individual with a history of trauma has little reason to trust, and will reject information that is inconsistent with their existing beliefs. Precluding themselves from social information in this way will create an apparent rigidity, or reluctance to change.

atoms.claim: 认知警觉表现为过度解读动机，可能是过度心智化的后果。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: High levels of epistemic vigilance (the overinterpretation of motives, and a possible consequence of hypermentalizing)

atoms.claim: 认识论不信任是认识论“饥饿”与不信任的结合。
clinical_signals: 患者难以信任和考虑所听到内容的真实性
therapeutic_implications: 临床医生若忽视这一知识将自担风险
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Epistemic mistrust is epistemic “hunger” combined with mistrust
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接定义，来自Box 1.17。

atoms.claim: 个体无法改变，因为他/她无法接受新信息与其他社会情境相关（即无法泛化）。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The individual cannot change because he/she is unable to accept new information as relevant to other social contexts (i.e., to generalize)
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自Box 1.16。

atoms.claim: 临床医生觉得患者没有在听，但现实是患者很难信任和考虑所听到内容的真实性。
therapeutic_implications: 临床医生应理解患者并非故意不合作
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Clinician feels that the patient is not listening, but the reality is that the patient finds it hard to trust and consider the truth or otherwise of what he/she hears.
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自Box 1.17。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 沟通改变系统1：内容教学与认知开放性增加
atoms.canonical_name_en: Communication change system 1: the teaching and learning of content and the increase of epistemic openness
atoms.claim: 所有循证心理治疗都提供一个连贯的框架，使患者能够在安全、低唤醒的情境下，根据特定理论方法检查其核心问题。
therapeutic_implications: 该框架作为明示线索，增加患者的认知信任，从而成为治疗成功的催化剂。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: All evidence-based psychotherapies provide a coherent framework that enables the patient to examine the issues that are deemed to be central to him/her, according to a particular theoretical approach, in a safe and low-arousal context.
atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确陈述。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 沟通系统2：心智化作为共同因素
atoms.canonical_name_en: Communication system 2: mentalizing as a common factor
atoms.claim: 治疗设置用于增加患者的心智化。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗环境本身有助于提升患者的心智化能力。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Communication system 2: mentalizing as a common factor: ● The therapeutic setting serves to increase the patient’s mentalizing
atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确陈述。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 沟通系统3：认知信任背景下的社会学习
atoms.canonical_name_en: Communication system 3: social learning in the context of epistemic trust
atoms.claim: 患者将其恢复的心智化应用于更广泛的社会环境，从而强化并建立在治疗中所学的内容。
therapeutic_implications: 社会学习在认知信任背景下发生，巩固治疗效果。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Communication system 3: social learning in the context of epistemic trust: ● The patient applies his/her restored mentalizing in the wider (social) environment, which reinforces and builds upon what he/she has learned in therapy.
atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确陈述。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 三个系统均针对BPD患者的认知不信任
atoms.canonical_name_en: All three systems address epistemic mistrust of patients with BPD
atoms.claim: 所有三个沟通系统都针对边缘型人格障碍患者的认知不信任。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗应系统性地处理患者的认知不信任。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: ◆ All three systems address the epistemic mistrust of patients with BPD
atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确陈述。

atoms.claim: MBT要求临床医生和患者在评估早期协作制定个案概念化，由临床医生撰写并与患者分享，并在有新理解时不断修订。
therapeutic_implications: 促进患者感到被理解和被认可
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Collaboratively develop a formulation early in the assessment process. This is written by the clinician and shared with the patient, and is constantly revised when new understanding develops.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用MBT要求的具体步骤。

atoms.claim: MBT要求绘制依恋模式及其在当前关系中的表现。
therapeutic_implications: 理解人际关系困难
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Map attachment patterns and how they play out in current relationships
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用MBT要求的具体步骤。

atoms.claim: MBT要求共同商定与患者相关的目标。
therapeutic_implications: 增强患者能动性
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Jointly agree goals that are relevant to the patient.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用MBT要求的具体步骤。

atoms.claim: MBT最初采取更具指导性和信息性的方法。
therapeutic_implications: 可能更清晰地传达对患者立场的认可
atoms.evidence_excerpt: MBT initially takes a more directive and informative approach
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用MBT的初始方法。

atoms.claim: 共同商定与患者相关的目标，使治疗围绕对患者重要的事情进行。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗聚焦于患者重要事项
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Jointly agree goals relevant to the patient so that therapy is about what is important to the patient.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述。

atoms.claim: 解释和建议可被视为示能线索，向患者发出信号，表明所传达的信息与其相关。
therapeutic_implications: 触发患者感到被临床医生或治疗情境个人认可
atoms.evidence_excerpt: we suggest that such explanations and suggestions may be seen as ostensive cues that signal to the patient the relevance to them of information that is being conveyed.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述。

atoms.canonical_name_en: increasing focus on affect and interpersonal interaction
atoms.claim: 在治疗过程中逐步聚焦情感和人际互动，为在通常会导致心智化丧失的依恋情境中探索更复杂的心理状态提供了背景。
therapeutic_implications: 提供探索复杂心理状态的背景
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Increasing focus on affect and interpersonal interaction during a session and over time provides the context in which to explore ever more complex states of mind within an attachment context that would normally trigger loss of mentalizing.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 临床医生主动展示心智化
atoms.claim: 临床医生的心智对患者开放，表现为临床医生主动展示对患者的心智化，陈述自己的想法并给出自己的视角。
therapeutic_implications: 临床医生主动展示心智化
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The mind of the clinician is open to the patient to the extent that the clinician actively demonstrates mentalizing about the patient, stating what is in his/her mind and giving his/her perspective.

atoms.canonical_name_en: subjectivity is held to be of importance and not subjugated
atoms.claim: 主体性被重视且不被压制；患者必须考虑临床医生的观点，如同临床医生必须考虑患者的观点。
therapeutic_implications: 患者和临床医生相互考虑对方观点
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Subjectivity is held to be of importance and not subjugated. The patient has to consider the clinician’s viewpoint just as the clinician has to consider the patient’s.

atoms.claim: 患者的心智化能力在所有有效的治疗中都会改善。
therapeutic_implications: 增加患者的自我控制感和自我连贯感
提高社会理解的准确性
减少心理痛苦体验
改善在依恋关系中连贯思考的能力
atoms.evidence_excerpt: the patient’s capacity to mentalize improves in all effective therapies. This is likely to have generic benefits in that it increases the patient’s self-control and sense of self-coherence; it increases the accuracy of their social understanding, reduces their experience of mental pain, and improves their ability to think coherently in the context of attachment relationships.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述心智化能力改善及其益处。

atoms.claim: 理解患者的主观性对于患者作为主动主体的自我发现至关重要。
therapeutic_implications: 患者通过社会互动体验到自己作为主体在临床医生思维中的存在
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Understanding the patient’s subjectivity is vital to this process, as the patient’s self-discovery as an active agent occurs through the social interchange where they experience themselves as an agent in the way their clinician thinks of them—it could be said that they “find themselves in the mind of the clinician.”
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述理解主观性的重要性。

atoms.claim: 真诚的“不知”立场是探索患者视角的基石。
therapeutic_implications: 形成探索患者视角的基础
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Authentic “not-knowing” stance that forms the bedrock for exploration of the patient’s perspective
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自Box 1.20，明确陈述。

atoms.claim: 共情验证是沟通系统2和MBT的一部分。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Empathic validation
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自Box 1.20列表项。

atoms.claim: 在患者和临床医生之间建立共享情感平台。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Establishing a shared affective platform held between patient and clinician
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自Box 1.20列表项。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 临床医生思维对患者开放
atoms.canonical_name_en: clinician's mind is open to the patient
atoms.claim: 临床医生的思维对患者开放。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mind of the clinician is “open” to the patient
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自Box 1.20列表项。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 视角在获得新信息时改变
atoms.canonical_name_en: perspectives change when new information becomes available
atoms.claim: 当新信息可用时，视角预期会改变；思维以交易方式改变思维。
therapeutic_implications: 思维以交易方式改变思维
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Perspectives are expected to change when new information becomes available; minds change minds in a transactional manner.
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自Box 1.20列表项。

atoms.claim: 心智化本身只是中间步骤，而非最终治疗目标。
therapeutic_implications: 仅仅聚焦于患者自身或他人的想法和感受不足以实现改变
atoms.evidence_excerpt: mentalizing in itself is only an intermediate step, not the ultimate therapeutic objective.
atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确陈述心智化是中间步骤而非最终目标。

atoms.claim: 真正持久的改善依赖于第三种沟通系统：从治疗之外的经验中学习。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗应促进患者从治疗外的社会经验中学习
atoms.evidence_excerpt: True and lasting improvement, we believe, rests on a third communication system: learning from experience beyond therapy.
atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确将真正持久的改善归因于第三种沟通系统。

atoms.claim: 克服认识论不信任，使之前被否认的积极社会信息得以被记录，从而让患者改变信念。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗应帮助患者克服认识论不信任
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Overcoming epistemic mistrust, so that positive social information that has previously been disavowed is now registered, enables the patient to alter his/her beliefs.
atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确陈述克服认识论不信任的作用。

atoms.claim: 被思考的体验增强心智化，进而使我们能够学习关于社会世界的新事物。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗中应让患者感受到被思考
atoms.evidence_excerpt: the experience of feeling thought about enhances mentalizing, which in turn enables us to learn new things about our social world
atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确陈述这一因果链。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 治疗关系中的依恋过程探索
atoms.canonical_name_en: exploration of attachment process in therapy relationship
atoms.claim: 治疗关系中依恋过程的探索不是终点，而只是有意义地关注患者生活中当前关系的一个阶段。
therapeutic_implications: 将治疗关系中的依恋探索作为手段，而非目的
重点转向患者当前的人际关系
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Exploration about attachment process in the therapy relationship is seen as not the end point but merely a stage to focus meaningfully on current relationships in the patient’s life.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述MBT观点。

atoms.claim: 认知过度警觉会干扰患者从互动中获取积极内容以及推动共同关系努力前进的能力。
therapeutic_implications: 帮助患者识别并放松认知过度警觉
促进信任和新的学习方式
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Too often, epistemic hypervigilance interferes with getting what is good in an interaction and finding what might propel a joint relational endeavor forward.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述认知过度警觉的干扰作用。

atoms.claim: 改善的认识信任使患者能够从社会经验中学习，从而在治疗之外维持第三个良性循环。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗应旨在恢复社会信息交换的能力，以促进认识信任。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The improved sense of epistemic trust derived from mentalizing enables learning from social experience; in this way the third virtuous cycle is maintained beyond therapy.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述认识信任改善的作用。

atoms.claim: 患者与临床医生在某一治疗时段中的联盟预测了下一时段的变化，表明时段间的改变是治疗引发的学习态度改变的结果。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗应关注患者时段间的行为改变，这反映了学习态度的转变。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Studies in which change was monitored session by session have suggested that the patient–clinician alliance in a given session predicts change in the next (Falkenstrom, Granstrom, & Holmqvist, 2013).
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确引用研究结果。

atoms.claim: 治疗期间患者的社会环境在很大程度上是良性的，这有助于心理治疗的成功。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗应考虑并可能促进患者社会环境的良性。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Because of this, we predict that psychotherapy for BPD is much more likely to succeed if the individual’s social environment at the time of treatment is largely benign.
atoms.extraction_notes: 文本使用“预测”一词，表明是推测性断言，但明确陈述。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 具体与非具体因素整合
atoms.canonical_name_en: integration of specific and nonspecific factors

therapeutic_implications: 治疗应包含具体因素以创造真实体验，同时促进心智化。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Specific factors associated with “therapies that work” create experiences of truth, which in turn encourage the patient to learn more. In this process, via a nonspecific pathway, the patient’s capacity to mentalize is fostered.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述具体与非具体因素的整合。

atoms.claim: 为了准确解释社会环境以提供新学习机会，理解他人行动和反应的心智状态至关重要。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗应培养患者对他人心智状态的理解。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: For the social environment to be accurately interpreted so that it can provide opportunities for new learning, mental state understanding of others’ actions and reactions is critical—and
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述心智状态理解的关键作用。

atoms.claim: 改善心智化是维持社会经验益处的关键，通过改善关系、情绪调节和良好行为控制来实现。

atoms.evidence_excerpt: only improved mentalizing will achieve this. For the benefit of social experience to be preserved through the maintenance of improved relationships, emotion regulation and good behavioral control are key—and, once again, only improved mentalizing will deliver these.
atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确陈述改善心智化是实现这些目标的关键。

atoms.claim: 自我导向涉及追求短期和长期生活目标的损害，以及在建设性和亲社会行为方式内运作和自我反思的能力。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗中需帮助患者建立目标导向行为
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The second interpersonal element is that of self-direction. This involves impairments in the pursuit of both short-term and long-term life goals; operating within constructive and prosocial ways of behavior; and self-reflection.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用DSM-5替代模型中关于自我导向的描述。

atoms.claim: 共情是DSM-5替代模型中描述的人际功能要素之一，被概念化为理解和欣赏他人体验的能力，以及容忍不同观点的能力。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗中需增强共情能力
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Empathy is one of the interpersonal elements of functioning described in the DSM-5 alternative model. It is conceptualized as the ability to comprehend and appreciate others’ experiences; the capacity for tolerating differing
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用DSM-5替代模型中关于共情的描述。注意原文句子未完整，但已提取关键信息。

atoms.claim: 心智化是对指导行为的想法和感受的准确理解。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: These are all underpinned by mentalizing—the accurate understanding of the thoughts and feelings that direct behavior.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 情绪失调与心智化失衡

therapeutic_implications: 帮助患者重新建立对他人心理状态的表征

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 压力下的战斗或逃跑反应
atoms.canonical_name_en: fight or flight response to stress

atoms.evidence_excerpt: Up to a point this is a normal “fight or flight” response to stress, which has the evolutionary advantage of allowing a person to respond to physical danger immediately and without reflection.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心理等价模式中情绪与认知的过度真实
atoms.canonical_name_en: emotions and cognitions become too real in psychic equivalence
atoms.claim: 当这种情绪体验世界的方式扩展到认知时——即想法和感受都变得“过于真实”——会导致一种不允许替代视角的心态，使情绪本身感觉高度即时且完全不可质疑。
clinical_signals: 情绪感觉高度即时且不可质疑
atoms.evidence_excerpt: When this emotional way of experiencing the world is extended to cognitions—when both thoughts and feelings become “too real”—it leads to a state of mind that allows no alternative perspective. It makes the emotions themselves feel highly immediate and completely unquestionable
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接描述心理等价模式扩展到认知时的状态。

atoms.claim: 目的论模式是一种非心智化状态，高度聚焦于外部可观察的物理结果，个体只接受物理行动作为他人意图的真实表达。

therapeutic_implications: 需要帮助患者认识到言语表达也可以具有真实意义
可能需要通过物理行动建立信任，再逐步过渡到言语层面
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The teleological mode of prementalizing involves a heavy emphasis on observable, physical outcomes. In teleological mode, the individual cannot accept anything other than a physical action as a true expression of someone’s intentions.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了目的论模式的定义和特征。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 反社会型人格障碍中心智化的工具性使用

atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述了ASPD患者心智化他人的目的。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 反社会型人格障碍中的外部心智化缺陷

therapeutic_implications: 治疗中可能需要更依赖言语而非非言语线索
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Individuals with ASPD show a particular inability to read facial expressions that convey affect.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述了ASPD患者的面部表情识别缺陷。

atoms.claim: 攻击行为只有在心智化暂时被抑制或解耦时才可能发生。
therapeutic_implications: 促进心智化可能减少攻击行为
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Aggressive acts are possible only if mentalizing is temporarily inhibited or decoupled.

atoms.claim: 假装模式使个体以解离的方式实施暴力，仿佛犯罪中没有心理受害者，或受害者的心智与施暴者截然不同，无法建立连续性。
clinical_signals: 缺乏对受害者心理状态的认知
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Pretend mode allows the individual to undertake violence in a disconnected way, as if there is no psychological victim involved in a crime or the victim’s mind is so alien and different from the perpetrator’s that no continuity between the two could be established.

atoms.claim: 假装模式下，个体可能反思自己的反社会行为，但找不到有意义的反思内容。
clinical_signals: 对自身反社会行为反思无意义
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Individuals with ASPD can sometimes reflect on their own antisocial actions in this mode and find nothing compelling to reflect on.

atoms.claim: 对于反社会型人格障碍患者，通过“思考关于思考”来促进行为改变通常无效。
contraindications: 通过“思考关于思考”改变行为
atoms.evidence_excerpt: A person with ASPD does not experience mental pain when thinking about someone else’s state of mind; thus, attempting to generate behavior change in people with ASPD by “thinking about thinking” will typically be ineffective.

atoms.claim: 对于反社会型人格障碍患者，普通的心理治疗可能无效，因为讨论内心状态与现实缺乏真正联系，不被体验为有意义。
contraindications: 普通心理治疗
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Importantly, ordinary psychological therapy can be fruitless because the discussion of internal states carries little genuine connection with reality and is not experienced as having meaning.

therapeutic_implications: 治疗需帮助患者识别并调节这种唤醒

atoms.claim: 解决脆弱、羞耻或软弱等难以承受的感受的螺旋式升级，在于将这些感受外化到他人身上。
therapeutic_implications: 临床医生需要挑战患者对关系的僵化概念化，但需非常小心，因为这种挑战可能引发暴力和攻击的感受
response_constraints: 挑战需谨慎，因为任何感知到的关系变化都会引发暴力控制需求的自动反应
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The resolution of this spiral lies in externalizing the unbearable feelings of vulnerability, shame, or weakness on to someone else. The imperative to externalize the alien self creates challenges for treatment: the rigidity with which relationships are conceptualized needs to be challenged by the clinician, but with great care, as such a challenge may arouse feelings of violence and aggression because any perceived changes in relationships unleash a need for the violent assertion of control as an automatic response.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述外化异己自我是解决螺旋的方式，并指出治疗挑战。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 早期问题行为与持续攻击风险

therapeutic_implications: 早期干预可能降低持续攻击风险
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Longitudinal studies such as the National Institute of Child Health and Human Development (NICHD) study (NICHD Early Child Care Research Network, 2004) have demonstrated that the earlier the onset of problem behaviors, the higher the risk for continued aggression and violence.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用研究结论。

atoms.evidence_excerpt: People with ASPD have typically never had the opportunity to learn about mental states in the context of appropriate attachment relationships.

atoms.evidence_excerpt: MBT was superior to this intervention, particularly in the long term (Bateman & Fonagy, 2013).
atoms.extraction_notes: 引用Bateman & Fonagy, 2013支持长期优势。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化治疗对边缘型人格障碍的疗效证据
atoms.canonical_name_en: Evidence for MBT efficacy in BPD
atoms.claim: 三项近期研究进一步支持了心智化治疗对边缘型人格障碍的疗效。
therapeutic_implications: 心智化治疗对边缘型人格障碍有效
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Three recent studies provide further support for the efficacy of MBT in BPD.
atoms.extraction_notes: 声明基于文本中提到的三项近期研究。

source_anchor.section_title: 2 USING THE MENTALIZING MODEL TO UNDERSTAND PERSONALITY DISORDER

supporting_anchors.section_title: 2 USING THE MENTALIZING MODEL TO UNDERSTAND PERSONALITY DISORDER

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化治疗对边缘型人格障碍的日间医院疗效
atoms.claim: 边缘型人格障碍的日间医院治疗并不比一般精神科护理更昂贵，并且在治疗后显示出可观的成本节约。
therapeutic_implications: 日间医院心智化治疗具有成本效益
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Analysis of participants’ healthcare use suggested that day hospital treatment for BPD was no more expensive than general psychiatric care and showed considerable cost savings after treatment.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述了成本效益。

source_anchor.section_title: 2 USING THE MENTALIZING MODEL TO UNDERSTAND PERSONALITY DISORDER

supporting_anchors.section_title: 2 USING THE MENTALIZING MODEL TO UNDERSTAND PERSONALITY DISORDER

atoms.claim: MBT治疗结束时的效应在18个月自然随访中得以维持。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: An 18-month naturalistic follow-up found that treatment effects at termination were sustained at 18 months (Jørgensen et al., 2014).
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自丹麦研究的随访。

atoms.claim: 从传统心理动力治疗转为MBT后，非计划出院减少，MBT脱落率低至2%。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The change in program from traditional psychodynamic therapy to MBT led to a reduction in unplanned discharges (MBT had a low dropout rate of 2%).
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自挪威质量改进研究。

atoms.canonical_name_en: MBT improves symptom and interpersonal functioning
atoms.claim: 从传统心理动力治疗转为MBT后，在症状困扰、人际、总体和职业功能方面有更大改善。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Measured benefits from the change of program included greater improvements in symptom distress and interpersonal, global, and occupational functioning.
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自挪威质量改进研究。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: MBT与其他治疗相比的效应量
atoms.claim: 一项倾向评分匹配研究显示，MBT的前后测效应量持续较大，精神症状减少的Cohen's d在18个月和36个月分别为-1.06和-1.42，人格功能改善的d范围为0.81至2.08。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: pre–post effect sizes were consistently large for MBT, with Cohen’s d for reduction in psychiatric symptoms of −1.06 and −1.42 at 18 and 36 months, respectively, and ds ranging from 0.81 to 2.08 for improvement in domains of personality functioning.
atoms.extraction_notes: 由于非随机研究设计和治疗剂量差异，组间差异应谨慎解释。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 反社会型人格障碍治疗证据匮乏
atoms.claim: 英国NICE临床指南确认，截至2009年，针对ASPD的干预措施研究不足，治疗证据稀缺。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Research into treatment for ASPD up to the year 2009 is summarized in the UK NICE clinical guideline for ASPD (National Institute for Health and Clinical Excellence 2010), which confirmed that interventions for ASPD are poorly researched and that evidence on its treatment is scarce.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 共病反社会型人格障碍的边缘型人格障碍的心理化治疗
atoms.canonical_name_en: MBT for BPD with comorbid ASPD
atoms.claim: 在边缘型人格障碍的MBT门诊治疗试验中，共病反社会型人格障碍的亚组从MBT中显著获益。
therapeutic_implications: MBT对共病ASPD的BPD患者可能有效
atoms.evidence_excerpt: A separate analysis of these individuals with comorbid ASPD revealed that they benefited significantly from MBT.
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自Bateman & Fonagy 2009的试验，但未提供具体数据。
population_details: 共病反社会型人格障碍的边缘型人格障碍患者

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 共病抑郁与边缘型人格障碍
atoms.claim: 抑郁与边缘型人格障碍高度共病，抑郁心境是边缘型人格障碍的关键特征。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗需考虑共病影响
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Depression and borderline personality disorder (BPD) are highly comorbid: depressive mood is a key feature of BPD.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述共病关系。

atoms.claim: 共病边缘型人格障碍的抑郁患者情感不稳定性更高，应激事件与抑郁发作的关系不如无边缘特征的抑郁患者明显。
clinical_signals: 应激与抑郁关系不明显
therapeutic_implications: 治疗需关注情感不稳定性和应激管理
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Depressed patients with comorbid BPD have greater affective instability; this makes the relationship between stressful experiences and the onset of depression less obvious than that typically seen in depressed patients without borderline features (Kopala-Sibley, Zuroff, Russell, Moskowitz, & Paris, 2012).
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述共病患者的临床特征。

atoms.claim: 在心理等价模式下，感知到的批评被视为对自我的高度威胁性攻击，拒绝可能被感受为字面意义上的痛苦。
clinical_signals: 感知批评为威胁性攻击
atoms.evidence_excerpt: in the psychic equivalence mode, perceived criticisms are felt as highly threatening attacks on the self: rejection can be felt as literally painful

atoms.claim: 在BPD抑郁患者中，自伤行为源于混乱的自我结构，自我批评的想法感觉真实，对抛弃和丧失的恐惧被体验为事实。
clinical_signals: 自我批评想法感觉真实
对抛弃和丧失的恐惧被体验为事实
atoms.evidence_excerpt: ◆ Psychic equivalence: ● Self-harm arises in the context of the disorganized self-structure of BPD ● Self-critical thoughts feel real ● Fear of abandonment and loss are experienced as a fact
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自Box 3.3，明确列出心理等价模式在BPD抑郁中的表现。

atoms.claim: 在BPD抑郁患者中，假装模式表现为低心智化后反弹为过度心智化，以及失败和徒劳的自我实现逻辑，自杀可能成为过度心智化过程的一部分。
clinical_signals: 低心智化后过度心智化
失败和徒劳的自我实现逻辑
自杀作为过度心智化过程
atoms.evidence_excerpt: ◆ Pretend mode: ● Hypomentalizing followed by rebound hypermentalizing ● Self-fulfilling logic of failure and futility ● Suicide as part of a hypermentalizing process
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自Box 3.3，明确列出假装模式在BPD抑郁中的表现。

atoms.claim: 在BPD抑郁患者中，目的论模式表现为坚持要求依恋人物、要求额外治疗次数以及潜在的边界侵犯。
therapeutic_implications: 需警惕边界侵犯
atoms.evidence_excerpt: ◆ Teleological mode: ● Insistent demand for attachment figures ● Requirement for extra sessions ● Potential boundary violations.
atoms.extraction_notes: 来自Box 3.3，明确列出目的论模式在BPD抑郁中的表现。

atoms.claim: 在抑郁患者中，无论是否合并BPD，都可以识别出非心智化模式，这些模式在个体心智化能力崩溃时可能主导功能。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: In other words, we can identify nonmentalizing in depressed patients both with and without BPD features, and these modes of functioning can come to dominate as the individual experiences breakdowns in his/her mentalizing abilities.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确说明非心智化模式在抑郁患者中普遍存在。

atoms.claim: 无BPD的抑郁患者具有更强的外显、受控、有意识的心智化能力。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: However, patients without BPD have a stronger capacity for explicit, controlled, conscious, ◆ Psychic equivalence:
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确对比了有无BPD患者的心智化能力差异。注意原文在“conscious,”后中断，但结合上下文，该句完整意思为无BPD患者有更强的外显、受控、有意识的心智化能力。

atoms.claim: 对共病BPD的抑郁症患者，采用关注心理表征的方法可能无益甚至有害，可能阻碍治疗联盟发展，引起焦虑或唤起，导致非心智化模式（尤其是假装模式）。
therapeutic_implications: 应避免使用心理表征方法
contraindications: 心理表征方法可能对共病BPD的抑郁症患者有害
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Patients with comorbid BPD may find the demands of such an approach unhelpful or even iatrogenic; the demands it makes may impede the development of the patient–clinician alliance and cause disruptive levels of anxiety or arousal, resulting in the use of nonmentalizing modes, particularly pretend mode.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述该方法可能无益甚至有害，并列出具体风险。
population_details: 共病边缘型人格障碍的抑郁症患者

atoms.claim: 对共病BPD的抑郁症患者，采用主动、结构化、支持性和人际性的、以加强心智化为重点的方法更有益。
therapeutic_implications: 采用主动、结构化、支持性和人际性的心智化强化方法
atoms.evidence_excerpt: An approach focused on strengthening mentalizing that is active, structured, supportive, and interpersonal will, we believe, be of more benefit to such patients.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确推荐该方法。
population_details: 共病边缘型人格障碍的抑郁症患者

atoms.claim: BPD患者的自杀意念和自杀行为可能与更高的冲动性和攻击性有关，这反映了目的论模式对主观性的更强控制。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The high rates of suicide and suicidal ideation in BPD patients are probably linked to higher levels of impulsivity and aggression, both of which reflect the stronger grip that the teleological mode has over subjectivity.
atoms.extraction_notes: 使用“probably linked”表示强烈暗示。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 无BPD抑郁症患者的自杀想法
atoms.claim: 无共病BPD的抑郁症患者的自杀想法和行为更“与客体相关”，通常直接与其人际环境、严厉的自我批评感、关于“杀死”自我讨厌部分的感觉或与失去的亲人团聚有关。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Suicidal thoughts and behavior in depressed patients without comorbid BPD are more “object related,” often directly connected to their interpersonal circumstances, to harsh feelings of self-criticism, feelings about “killing off” hated parts of the self, or reuniting with lost loved ones.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述无BPD抑郁症患者自杀想法的特点。
population_details: 无共病边缘型人格障碍的抑郁症患者

atoms.canonical_name_en: Phase 1: Focus on the patient's mind
atoms.claim: MBT治疗抑郁的核心特征是对患者心智而非行为的持续关注。
therapeutic_implications: 干预主要针对将人际过程与患者的心智状态联系起来
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The core feature throughout the three phases is an unwavering focus on the patient’s mind rather than his/her behavior.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 治疗阶段一：主动支持共情立场
atoms.claim: 第一阶段旨在通过采取主动、支持和共情的治疗立场来吸引患者参与治疗。
therapeutic_implications: 提供希望和结构
与患者积极合作以支持人际改变
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Engaging the patient in treatment by adopting an active, supportive, and empathic therapeutic stance, providing hope and structure, and working actively together with the patient to support interpersonal change.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 治疗阶段一：识别焦虑与防御
atoms.claim: 临床医生需帮助患者识别在鼓励、思考或尝试改变时可能触发的焦虑和防御（即改变的障碍）。
therapeutic_implications: 清除路径以便患者尝试更适应的人际关系方式
atoms.evidence_excerpt: This requires a concerted effort on the part of the clinician to help the patient identify the anxieties and defenses (i.e., the obstacles to change) that may be triggered when change is encouraged, contemplated, and/or attempted, so that the path can be cleared for the patient to experiment with more adaptive ways of relating to others.

atoms.claim: 处理防御包括识别患者的防御及其代价；验证而非解释防御以抵消不可避免的羞耻感；这有助于患者对自己更有同情心，并能更好地调节焦虑和羞耻。
therapeutic_implications: 验证防御而非解释
增强自我同情
改善焦虑和羞耻调节
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Working with defenses: this work entails recognition of the patient’s defenses and their cost; validation and not interpretation of the defense to counteract inevitable shame—this helps the patient to feel more compassionate toward themselves and can lead to better regulation of anxiety and shame
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述了处理防御的要素和效果。

atoms.claim: 通过积极鼓励患者反思和尝试应对逆境的新方法，特别是与他人和自我的新关系方式，来培养面对过去、现在和未来逆境的韧性。
therapeutic_implications: 鼓励反思和尝试新方法
关注与他人和自我的新关系
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Fostering resilience in the face of past, current, and future adversity by actively encouraging the patient to reflect on and try out new ways of dealing with adversity, particularly new ways of relating to others and the self.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了培养韧性的方法。

atoms.claim: 第三阶段旨在处理由治疗即将结束引发的丧失、分离、自主性和身份认同问题，通过鼓励患者表达与治疗终止相关的恐惧和愿望。
therapeutic_implications: 鼓励表达恐惧和愿望
处理丧失和分离
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Working through issues around loss and separation, as well as autonomy and identity, that are triggered by the impending end of the treatment (e.g., fears of losing the clinician, fears of relapsing, fear of failure when going back to work, etc.) by encouraging the patient to express his/her fears and wishes relating to the upcoming termination of treatment.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了第三阶段的目标。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 处理患者-临床医生关系中的人际问题
atoms.canonical_name_en: Working through interpersonal issues within the patient–clinician relationship
atoms.claim: 第三阶段包括处理患者-临床医生关系中的人际问题。
clinical_signals: 治疗关系中的冲突或问题
therapeutic_implications: 处理治疗关系中的人际问题
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Working through interpersonal issues within the patient–clinician relationship
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确列出为第三阶段目标之一。

atoms.claim: 第三阶段包括验证和认可（而非解释）防御。
therapeutic_implications: 验证和认可防御
避免解释
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Validation and recognition (not interpretation) of defenses
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确列出为第三阶段目标之一。

atoms.claim: BPD中的依恋创伤被概念化为反复经历在无法忍受的情绪状态中被心理上独自留下的经历。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Attachment trauma in BPD is conceptualized as repeated experiences of being left psychologically alone in an unbearable emotional state.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 共病抑郁的治疗时长调整
atoms.claim: 对于共病BPD的抑郁患者，可能需要更长期的、开放式的治疗，更详细地关注当前和过去关系及功能之间的联系。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: depressed patients with comorbid BPD may need a longer, open-ended treatment that focuses in more detail on the links between current and past relationships and functioning.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述治疗时长和焦点。

atoms.claim: 经历过创伤的人的心智化能力常常受损。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗需要创造安全的依恋环境以促进心智化
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Research has shown that the capacity for mentalizing is often damaged in people who have experienced trauma.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述，无额外推断。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 治疗原则：创造安全的依恋环境以促进心智化
atoms.canonical_name_en: Treatment Principle: Creating a Secure Attachment Context Conducive to Mentalizing
atoms.claim: 治疗需要创造安全的依恋环境，以促进心智化，使先前难以承受的情绪状态变得可承受。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗应提供安全的依恋环境
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Treatment entails creating a secure attachment context conducive to mentalizing, in which emotional states that were previously unbearable can be rendered bearable.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述治疗原则。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 情绪调节与社会理解的分离是创伤的背景
atoms.canonical_name_en: Disjunction of Emotion Regulation and Social Understanding as Background to Trauma
atoms.claim: 情绪调节和社会理解的分离创造了创伤的背景。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗应关注整合情绪调节与社会理解
atoms.evidence_excerpt: the disjunction of these two processes creates the background to trauma.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述，上下文指情绪调节和社会理解。

atoms.claim: 创伤后个体可能通过物质滥用、自伤或暴食催吐等行动来保护自己免受闪回，这体现了目的论模式。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗需帮助患者发展心理层面的应对方式
atoms.evidence_excerpt: People who have been traumatized may also try to protect themselves against flashbacks through substance abuse, self-harm, or bingeing and purging (Nock, 2009; Roemer & Orsillo, 2009). Such actions typify the teleological mode.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述目的论模式在创伤后行为中的体现。

atoms.canonical_name_en: collapse of mentalizing in the face of trauma
atoms.claim: 创伤面前心理化的崩溃导致对内外现实关系失去觉察。
clinical_signals: 对内外现实关系失去觉察
therapeutic_implications: 治疗需帮助恢复心理化功能
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The collapse of mentalizing in the face of trauma entails a loss of awareness of the relationship between internal and external reality (Fonagy & Target, 2000).
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述心理化崩溃的核心特征。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心理等价与假装模式交替
atoms.canonical_name_en: oscillation between psychic equivalence and pretend mode
atoms.claim: 在心理等价和假装模式之间摇摆是创伤化的标志。
clinical_signals: 心理等价与假装模式交替出现
therapeutic_implications: 治疗需帮助患者稳定心理化功能
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Oscillating between psychic equivalence and pretend modes of experiencing the internal world is a hallmark of traumatization (see Box 3.8).
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述创伤化的标志。

atoms.claim: 心理化在感受和行动之间提供了一个缓冲——实际上是一个“暂停按钮”。
therapeutic_implications: 促进心理化以提供感受和行动之间的缓冲
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mentalizing provides a buffer between feeling and action—in effect, a “pause button” (Allen, 2001).
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述心理化作为缓冲的作用。

atoms.claim: 治疗创伤患者的总体目标是帮助他们建立一个更 robust 的心理化自我，使他们能够心理化创伤和冲突，从而发展更安全的依恋。
therapeutic_implications: 促进心理化自我发展
处理创伤和冲突
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The overall aim of treating traumatized patients is to help them to establish a more robust mentalizing self so that they become able to mentalize trauma and conflict, and thus to develop more secure attachments.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述治疗目标。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 通过依恋关系发展心理化自我
atoms.canonical_name_en: finding one's authentic psychological self through the mind of a benign attachment figure
atoms.claim: 治疗通过一个发展上适当的过程来寻找或恢复心理化——即通过一个参与互惠心理化关系的良性依恋人物的心智来发现自己的真实心理自我。
therapeutic_implications: 提供互惠心理化的依恋关系
atoms.evidence_excerpt: It entails finding or recovering mentalizing through a developmentally appropriate process—that is, finding one’s authentic psychological self through the mind of a benign attachment figure who is engaged in a reciprocal mentalizing relationship (see Box 3.9).
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述治疗过程。

atoms.claim: 所有生活中不可避免的痛苦都像裸露的伤口一样被体验，没有心理化提供的“皮肤”保护。
therapeutic_implications: 增强心理化以提供保护
atoms.evidence_excerpt: All the inescapable pains of life are experienced with the immediacy of an open wound unprotected by the “skin” that mentalizing provides.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接比喻心理化作为保护层。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 治疗促进对自我而非仅创伤的心理化
atoms.canonical_name_en: treatment fosters mentalizing in relation to the patient's self, not just trauma
atoms.claim: 治疗促进对患者自我的心理化，而不仅仅是针对其创伤。
therapeutic_implications: 关注自我心理化
atoms.evidence_excerpt: In this vein, treatment fosters mentalizing in relation to the patient’s self, not just in relation to his/her trauma.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述治疗重点。

atoms.claim: 心理化给压倒性的情绪和冲动行为踩刹车，为监控和理解自我和他人的动机提供机会。
therapeutic_implications: 促进心理化以提供暂停和反思
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mentalizing puts the brakes on overwhelming emotions and impulsive actions, providing an opportunity for the motivations of self and other to be monitored and understood.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述心理化的功能。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 患者破坏性行为对治疗关系的风险
atoms.canonical_name_en: destructive behavior of patient can destroy potential for secure attachment
atoms.claim: 患者的破坏性行为可能引发与其相处的人无法忍受的情绪状态，从而有效破坏安全依恋的潜力以及心理化的重新点燃。
therapeutic_implications: 管理反移情
维持治疗框架
contraindications: 破坏性行为可能破坏治疗关系
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The destructive behavior of the patient can elicit unbearable emotional states in the person they are with, which effectively destroys the potential for secure attachment and with it the rekindling of mentalizing.
atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述破坏性行为的风险。

atoms.claim: 童年创伤可能改变心智化模式的切换点，使个体在应激/唤醒水平尚未高到足以抑制他人控制性心智化时，就做出反应。
clinical_signals: 应激/唤醒水平升高时心智化受损
therapeutic_implications: 监测创伤患者对谈论想法和感受的准备程度
在建立唤醒管理之前谨慎进行解释性工作
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Childhood trauma may shift the switch point between the two modes of mentalizing: people with a history of trauma often respond to increases in stress/arousal that would not be high enough to inhibit controlled mentalizing in others.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 创伤患者的心智化治疗优先事项
atoms.canonical_name_en: clinical priority of mentalizing treatment for trauma
atoms.claim: 创伤心智化治疗的临床优先事项必须是降低唤醒水平，使患者能够再次思考其他视角，即进行心智化。
clinical_signals: 无法处理关于心智的谈话
therapeutic_implications: 降低唤醒水平
避免在患者无法承受时进行解释
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The clinical priority of mentalizing treatment for trauma must be reducing arousal so that the patient can again think about other perspectives—that is, to mentalize.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 创伤患者中解释性工作的禁忌
atoms.canonical_name_en: caution about interpretive work for trauma patients
atoms.claim: 对于共病创伤和边缘型人格障碍的患者，MBT建议在建立唤醒管理之前谨慎进行解释性工作。
clinical_signals: 无法处理关于心智的谈话
therapeutic_implications: 推迟解释性工作
先管理唤醒
contraindications: 在唤醒未管理时进行解释性工作
atoms.evidence_excerpt: MBT advises caution about interpretive work for these patients until management of arousal is established.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 提供安全与容纳的环境
atoms.canonical_name_en: providing a safe and containing environment
atoms.claim: 提供安全与容纳的环境是治疗的必要前提。
therapeutic_implications: 建立安全可靠的治疗框架
关注患者对治疗的体验
以真诚兴趣和透明回应焦虑或问题
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Providing a safe and containing environment is therefore an essential prerequisite for treatment.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 创伤后自我连续性断裂
atoms.canonical_name_en: disconnection between pre-trauma and post-trauma self
atoms.claim: 持续沉浸在创伤过去会切断创伤前自我与创伤后自我之间的联系，患者被创伤定义。
clinical_signals: 创伤后自我连续性断裂
atoms.evidence_excerpt: it severs the connection between the person’s pre-trauma self and post-trauma self: he/she becomes defined by the trauma as it replays itself over and over again.

atoms.claim: 叙事连贯性被确定为创伤后应激障碍暴露治疗中的改变机制。
therapeutic_implications: 发展创伤叙事以连接创伤前和创伤后自我，并具有前瞻性
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Foa, Huppert, and Cahill (2006) identified narrative coherence as a mechanism of change in exposure treatment for PTSD.

atoms.claim: 临床医生应将部分心智化过程聚焦于非创伤功能，以更细致地探索当前的思维和感受。
therapeutic_implications: 将心智化过程聚焦于非创伤功能
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Clinician should focus some mentalizing process on nontraumatized functioning for a more nuanced exploration of current thinking and feeling

atoms.claim: 重建工作用于识别令人困惑的刺激，但明确聚焦于当前对个体心理体验的影响。
therapeutic_implications: 使用重建工作识别令人困惑的刺激，聚焦当前影响
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Reconstruction work is used to identify confusing stimuli but with a clear focus on the current effect on the individual’s mental experience.

atoms.claim: 重建是任何治疗过程的重要组成部分，在处理创伤患者时尤其相关。
clinical_signals: 创伤患者记忆编码问题
therapeutic_implications: 提供安全环境
帮助患者回忆创伤体验及相关情感和意义
逐步解包认知和情感成分
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Reconstruction is an important component of any therapeutic process, and this is especially relevant when working with traumatized patients.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述重建的重要性，并特别适用于创伤患者。

atoms.claim: 进食障碍与人格障碍（尤其是边缘型人格障碍）之间存在高共病率。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: High rates of comorbidity between eating disorders and personality disorders, particularly BPD, have long been observed by clinicians.

atoms.claim: 约30%的进食障碍患者同时符合人格障碍的诊断标准。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Godt (2008) reported that 30% of patients with an eating disorder also meet criteria for personality disorder

atoms.claim: 边缘型人格障碍与神经性贪食症之间存在特别强的关联。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: with there being a particularly strong connection between BPD and bulimia nervosa.

atoms.claim: 针对共病的心智化方法旨在针对两种疾病共同的心智化丧失。
therapeutic_implications: target the loss of mentalizing that is common to both conditions
atoms.evidence_excerpt: A mentalizing approach to this comorbidity thus seeks to target the loss of mentalizing that is common to both conditions.

atoms.claim: 共病边缘型人格障碍和进食障碍的患者呈现出一系列复杂的挑战，两种障碍之间的转换率很高。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Patients with comorbid BPD and eating disorders clearly present a complex set of challenges, with high levels of movement from one disorder to another

atoms.claim: 同时患有两种疾病的个体比仅患进食障碍的个体更可能有复杂的病程。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Individuals with both conditions rather than an eating disorder alone are more likely to have a complicated course

atoms.claim: 进食障碍被理解为混乱自我感的表达。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Eating disorders are understood as an expression of a disordered sense of self.

atoms.claim: 证据表明进食障碍与心智化困难之间存在强关联。
